summary: The two figure comparisons reproduce: 19/20 gene directions agree in the original paper and 15/15 in the follow-up. All 69 manifest files matched their hashes and sizes, although the saved GEO landing page is a reCAPTCHA screen. The corrected proposal retains the figure-level comparison and marks the detailed review unresolved. It passed the proposal validator.
openIssues: Crhr1 reverses sign, and only Mc3r passes the registered BH cutoff among ten author-marked discoveries. The original Cuffdiff export is needed to reconcile these differences and assess genome-wide overlap.
The original paper gives conflicting accounts of Pomc significance. The follow-up depicts C3 in two positive color bands, supporting its direction alone.
Each figure falls below the 30-pair concordance minimum. The sequenced animals’ cage assignments remain unknown.
